CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  February 10, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – January 27, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the January 27, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the January 27, 2026, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-065
  • 501 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Wei Quan & Zhuangming Xie
  • Request: This is an application for new signage on an existing 1-
  story commercial restaurant building known as Taste of Chao Chan.

  1
  02/10/2026
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall clarify whether the proposed channel letter
  returns and trim caps are to be finished in matte black or
  white. The description and elevation colors are currently
  inconsistent and must be revised to reflect a consistent finish.
  2. For clarity of the proposed signage, the tan background
  shown on the signage detail shall be removed. The tan color,
  if intended to represent the existing stucco wall, can be
  acknowledged by the existing site photograph.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall clarify whether the proposed channel letter
  returns and trim caps are to be finished in matte black or
  white. The description and elevation colors are currently
  inconsistent and must be revised to reflect a consistent finish.
  2. For clarity of the proposed signage, the tan background
  shown on the signage detail shall be removed. The tan color,
  if intended to represent the existing stucco wall, can be
  acknowledged by the existing site photograph.

  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-001
  • 5 East Main Street
  • Applicant: Kathy Lovell
  • Request: This is an application for a new exterior paint color scheme
  for an existing 1-story commercial center known as the Alhambra
  Renaissance Center.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  2
  02/10/2026
   Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-129
  • 1836 South Seventh Street
  • Applicant: Alison Fung & Kaizen Chen
  • Request: This is an application for the replacement of all existing
  windows on an existing 1-story Ranch-style single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Note that all existing and new window sill and trim shall be
  painted to match the exterior window frame color.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Note that all existing and new window sill and trim shall be
  painted to match the exterior window frame color.
  2. Provide a note on the plans stating that muntins shall be
  applied to the exterior face of the glass for all six (6) gridded
  windows, as indicated on the elevations.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Vice Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-161
  • 1012 Geranio Drive
  • Applicant: Ricky Huang
  • Request: This is an application for a front porch redesign, the
  installation of three new windows, and a 157 SF rear addition to an
  existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise the roof plan to reflect a simplified
  porch roof design. The revised plans should either
  demonstrate a porch roof that is fully integrated with the main
  roof structure or designed as a defined shed roof form.

  3
  02/10/2026
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise the roof plan to reflect a simplified
  porch roof design. The revised plans should either
  demonstrate a porch roof that is fully integrated with the main
  roof structure or designed as a defined shed roof form.

  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-114
  • 400 North Valencia Street
  • Applicant: Miguel Alvarado & Ruben Hernandez
  • Request: This is an application for a new 458 SF addition, a new 64
  SF uncovered rear patio, exterior alterations, and site improvements
  to an existing single-family residential property.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide a note on the plans stating that muntins shall be
  applied to the exterior face of the glass for all gridded
  windows, as indicated on the elevations.
  2. Revise the configuration of the north retaining wall along the
  property line adjacent to the neighboring property to
  incorporate stepped elevations as the grade increases, or
  alternatively, to be designed with a gradual slope.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Vice Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
  4
  02/10/2026
   ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-133
  • 1840 South Fourth Street
  • Applicant: Dat Wong
  • Request: This is an application for the demolition of the existing main
  residence, including the garage and patio, and the construction of a
  new 2,320 SF 2-story single-family residence with an attached two-
  car garage located at the rear of the property.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the vehicular sliding gate design to incorporate
  decorative detailing consistent with the proposed railing
  design.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Vice Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:14 P.M. to
  Tuesday, February 24, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

ATTEST:

Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
